concept: JINGZHANG WORK, NOT TRAINING / 京张不跟班
public_problem: Ordinary work under livelihood pressure must not be interpreted as voluntary AI training contribution.

gates.pass: ordinary task and optional demonstration are separately documented
sensor, purpose, retention and physical envelope are registered
gates.fail: cut power and remove collection device

gates.pass: staffed accessible explanation covers pay, derivative use and withdrawal
choice is separate, private, revocable and not inferred
physical cut-off works and no sensor crosses the envelope
file-model-interface derivatives have owners and status
no-account receipt and condition comparison are complete
gates.fail: keep HOLD and preserve ordinary work/livelihood

ai_prohibited: decide wages, shifts, access or discipline
ai_off: Paper registers, physical cut-off, staffed explanation, derivative cabinet and independent receipts complete the task.

five_field_difference.people: workers whose choices occur under employment, contractor or platform livelihood pressure
five_field_difference.task: separate ordinary work from optional demonstration, verify no retaliation, trace derivatives, withdraw and preserve livelihood
five_field_difference.space: ordinary-work line plus voluntary pocket, physical cut-off, derivative room and independent seat
five_field_difference.human_right: refuse, stop, inspect use, withdraw and appeal without loss of wages, shifts, access, tools or facilities
five_field_difference.failure_result: training and disputed derivatives stop; ordinary work, livelihood and facilities continue
